notes:
Refunds
- A Coupang refund that equals one earlier Coupang charge is now taken off that purchase instead of counting as income, whether the purchase is still in review or already in History.
- A partial refund gets a "Deduct from a purchase" button that lists the likely orders first. Any saved income can be deducted the same way from History.
- "Keep as income" or "Undo refund" puts it back, and importing the same statement again never deducts a refund twice.
- When the purchase was a split already sent to Telegram, Finish tells the group chat how much of the refund you will send back, and the total to send nets it out.
- Tapping a History row's title, date or amount now opens it.
